firmware.name: TouchVink
firmware.author: Jon Waterschoot
firmware.description: A feedback instrument after the self-regulating tape / ring-mod / reverb patches of Jaap Vink. One knob, one function.
firmware.notes:
## TouchVink
Source: [jonwaterschoot/TouchVink](https://github.com/jonwaterschoot/TouchVink). Interactive manual: [jonwaterschoot.github.io/TouchVink](https://jonwaterschoot.github.io/TouchVink/).

A delayed copy of the output is ring-modulated, reverberated and passed through a VCA that the loop's own loudness turns down, so the loop can run above unity gain and keep moving by itself.

## Pads
- **P00** · pads to OSC mode: P03–P09 pick the oscillator pitch and excite the loop; pressure bends up to an octave
- **P02** · pads to DIST mode: P03–P09 pick the distortion; pressure adds drive
- **P01** · steering: loop swells re-pick the oscillator pitch. Tap on / off, hold for momentary
- **P10** · attack 2 ms / 60 ms / 600 ms
- **P11** · decay, tap: 120 ms / 2 s / drone; hold ½ s: back to 120 ms
- **P10 + P11**, hold 1 s · recalibrate the pads

## Switches
- **S09-S10** · osc motion: LFO sweep / steady / drunk walk
- **S07-S08** · noise: pink / drift / brown

## MIDI
- ch 1 notes · oscillator pitch + excite
- ch 10 notes 36–47 · pads P0–P11
- CC 20–27 · S30–S37
- CC 28–34 · SW1, SW2, pad mode, attack, decay, steer, distortion
